channel.title: Ada incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Ada's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Investigating issues with Ada Voice service on US and Maple Clusters [resolved]
Elevated handoffs to live agents [resolved]
Elevated latency for Conversations and Analytics (US2) [resolved]
item.description: Query performance in US2 has returned to normal baseline levels and all affected endpoints. Conversation View, transcripts, conversation search, and analytics dashboards are responding at expected speeds.

item.title: Conversation View Delays [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Timing for conversations appearing in the conversations view has returned to normal. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Delayed AI Agent message delivery [resolved]
Increase in handoff rate during Playbook execution [resolved]
Availability Rule Variable Selector Is Unusable in Playbooks V1 + V2 [resolved]
Agent dashboards are unable to load. [resolved]
Ada Dashboard fails to load intermittently [resolved]
MCP server authentication is currently failing due to an outage in WorkOS [resolved]
item.description: WorkOS fix is now effective, and we have stopped monitoring the issue.

item.title: Outbound Emails via SMTP Connector from Zendesk in US Production Environment are not being sent to the End users [resolved]
item.description: A fix has been deployed, and queued Zendesk Emails are being sent out now.

item.title: Some AI Agent conversations transferring to a human agent [resolved]
item.description: The team was able to identify the root cause and a fix is in place.

item.title: Investigating issues with Ada Dashboard - Page Loading Errors [resolved]
Intermittent Chatbot Loading Issues in US Cluster [resolved]
Oracle Handoffs are failing [resolved]
Delayed responses and processing for some automated interactions [resolved]
item.description: Identified and resolved an issue affecting some internal background data processing. Our team corrected it and confirmed all systems have returned to normal operation.

item.title: Handoff Failing [resolved]
Delay in the Conversation view [resolved]
Investigating issues with Ada Chat services [resolved]
Elevated error rates on AI Agent responses [resolved]
item.description: The certificate rotation issue has been fully resolved. Error rates have returned to normal levels and services are operating as expected. No further impact is anticipated

item.title: Message processing errors [resolved]
Investigating issues with Ada Voice service [resolved]
item.description: Based on our Engineering Team's investigation, we have determined the scope of this issue is limited to a very small number of clients and affected conversations. We are continuing to work on the issue, but moving forward will be communicating on this issue on an individual basis.

item.title: Increase in Emergency Voice Handoffs [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved an issue that caused an increase in emergency handoffs for a subset of customers.

item.title: Language detection is currently showing degraded performance for language switching [resolved]
item.description: We have identified the root cause of the language detection issue affecting non-English responses. Improvements are actively in progress and will be delivered as part of our ongoing engineering work.
